incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired -> metrics_pipeline.MISSING_CRITICAL_METRIC (severity: high)
incident-bot: Alert keys: service_request_latency_seconds missing for >5m; rule: missing_time_series_count > 10
carla (oncall): ACK. I'm on it. Paging Ben for backup.
pagerduty-bot: carla (oncall) acknowledged the page (incident: PD-2026-3987). Escalation in 8m if not resolved.
ben (sre): on call. quick check: are we seeing scrape targets down or metric rename?
alice (eng): I just rolled a daemonset bump to exporter v2.1.0 -> v2.2.0 about 7m ago to pick up metadata fields. could be related.
dave (platform): checking prometheus targets and last scrape status...
dave (platform): `kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=node-exporter -o wide` shows rollout finishing ~8m ago.
dave (platform): prometheus: `/api/v1/targets?state=down` returns 0 down, but `/api/v1/series?match[]=service_request_latency_seconds` returns empty for last 6m.
carla (oncall): hmm metric missing but targets up. could be metric renamed in exporter. alice, what changed in v2.2.0?
alice (eng): changelog: renamed some labels and renamed `service_latency_seconds` -> `service_request_latency_seconds_v2` (my bad). We forgot to add a compatibility alias.
ben (sre): that would trigger the missing-metric alert. Ok, mitigation options: rollback exporter to v2.1.0 or deploy a compatibility shim. rollback is fastest.
carla (oncall): agree. Rollback now. Ben, can you run the rollback? I'll coordinate PD timeline and customer comms.
ben (sre): running `kubectl -n infra set image daemonset/node-exporter node-exporter=node-exporter:v2.1.0` then `kubectl rollout status daemonset/node-exporter -n infra`.
ben (sre): started rollback at 4078901250.
ben (sre): also adding a temporary recording rule to map `service_request_latency_seconds_v2` -> `service_request_latency_seconds` while rollback finishes.
dave (platform): note: we also have a concurrent S3 throttling event causing logs to backlog. I'm seeing increased write latency to s3-ingest bucket, causing log-forwarder retries. Could impact log enrichment for metrics.
carla (oncall): is the S3 issue customer-facing? any dashboards impacted?
dave (platform): yes, we're seeing ~30% of ingestion workers with exponential backoff; log write latency spikes to 5-10s. backlog queue length up ~120k messages.
alice (eng): separate but related: our metric producer for `service_request_latency_seconds` depends on enriched logs where the exporter reads trace IDs from logs. If logs delayed, some metrics might be missing even after metric name fix.
ben (sre): rollback complete at 4078901270. Prometheus series query shows `service_request_latency_seconds` reappearing (observed 4078901275). :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: incident PD-2026-3987: acknowledged by carla (oncall). status: acknowledged.
carla (oncall): good. Ben, monitor for 10m. Dave, can you throttle back ingestion and trigger backfill once S3 stabilizes?
dave (platform): yes — increasing concurrency to reduce retries is risky. I'm switching to backfill mode: pause real-time consumers and start s3-to-kafka backfill after S3 rate-limit subsides. Running `./ops/backfill --from=now-10m --to=now --topic=ingest-backfill`
dave (platform): opened ticket INF-542 in infra with S3 request IDs and CloudWatch metrics.
alice (eng): opened PR #764 to add a compatibility alias in the exporter to prevent future alert storms. will fast-track merge after incident.
carla (oncall): customer impact assessment: preliminary -> dashboards for ~4% of customers showed missing latency series in the last 15m, some alerting noise. No data plane downtime. I'm drafting a short customer note.
ben (sre): monitoring: suppress the missing-metric alert for 15m to avoid noise. `/ops/alert-suppress --alert=metrics_pipeline.MISSING_CRITICAL_METRIC --duration=15m --by=incident:PD-2026-3987`
ben (sre): suppression applied. :white_check_mark:
carla (oncall): PD escalation stopped. Ben keep an eye on the backfill job and confirm when backlog < 5k. Dave follow up on S3 limits with cloud provider. Alice after PR merge schedule a canary release to avoid full rollout.
dave (platform): backlog decreased to 18k at 4078901290, ingestion workers back to normal retry rates.
ben (sre): backlog <5k at 4078901299. marking incident as mitigated.
pagerduty-bot: PD-2026-3987: status changed to "mitigated" by ben (sre).
carla (oncall): filing incident ticket INC-2026-221 with timeline, root cause (exporter metric rename + transient S3 rate limits), customer impact, and action items: 1) exporter compatibility alias (alice) 2) release rollback playbook update (ben) 3) S3 rate-limit escalations and monitoring (dave).
carla (oncall): Assigning follow-ups and scheduling a postmortem tomorrow 10:00am PT. Thanks everyone. :heart:
alice (eng): will merge PR and add compatibility test to CI.
ben (sre): leaving note in runbook: if metric rename required, add rule to create alias + announce before rolling.
carla (oncall): handing to Ben for primary on-call for the rest of the evening. I'll create the customer blurb after a quick review.
ben (sre): taking over oncall. closing thread.
